properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 19 at 7:49PM EDT by NWS Blacksburg VA
properties.description:
At 749 PM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from near Ivanhoe to near Sparta. Movement was south
at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Sparta...
Independence...
Fries...
Twin Oaks...
Baywood...
and Spring Valley.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Locally heavy rain will quickly reduce visibility and result in
ponding of water on roadways, standing water in low lying areas, and
minor flooding of creeks, streams, and areas of poor drainage.
Drivers are urged to slow down and use extra caution to avoid
hydroplaning.

NWSheadline: STRONG THUNDERSTORMS WILL IMPACT NORTH CENTRAL ALLEGHANY COUNTY IN NORTHWESTERN NORTH CAROLINA...WEST CENTRAL CARROLL AND EASTERN GRAYSON COUNTIES IN SOUTHWESTERN VIRGINIA THROUGH 815 PM EDT
